scope: Proposition 3.1 (Exterior coefficients and the original-matrix resolvent) of the manuscript “The complete Crouzeix theorem: optimal similarity and a common positive boundary representation” (preprints/The-complete-Crouzeix-theorem-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 325 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b5e37fffcae2be84), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume the admissible Ω and the exterior map G supplied above. Write G(t) = at + b + O(t−1) at infinity, where a ̸= 0, and qG(t) = tG′(t). There are scalar polynomials bk, with b0 = 1, deg bk = k, and leading coefficient a−k, defined by qG(t) G(t) − z = X k≥0 bk(z)t−k at infinity. (3.1) There is also the mixed expansion B(w, t) = qG(t) G(t) − G(w) − t t − w = X i,j≥1 βijw−i t−j , bj(G(w)) = wj + X i≥1 βijw−i (j ≥ 1). (3.2) Here B is holomorphic through the diagonal and both infinities of the exterior product collar. For each r < ρ < 1 there is a constant Cρ such that |βij| ≤ Cρρi+j; the series converges normally on the product collar and absolutely uniformly on T2. The kernel m(w, t) = 1 + B(w, t) + B(w, t) is continuous and nonnegative, with each normalized-circle marginal one. For every finite n and every original matrix A ∈ Mn(C) with W(A) ⊂ Ω, KA(t) = qG(t)(G(t)I − A)−1 = X k≥0 bk(A)t−k , EA(t) = KA(t) + KA(t)∗ ⪰ 0 (t ∈ T). (3.3) Its coefficients decay geometrically and its series converges absolutely uniformly on T. The scalar case applies to every fixed z ∈ Ω.
